notes: Modified cash basis; cash roll-forward uses governmental fund balances (501,790 to 659,778). Governmental lines from Total Governmental Funds column (p5). Printed Total revenues 1,330,721 includes Bond/loan proceeds 107,000 (recorded as debt_proceeds, not a receipt); receipts lines sum to 1,223,721. Transfers in/out 7,700 each (Street in, General out). Governmental roll-forward: 501,790 + 1,223,721 - 1,172,733 + 7,700 - 7,700 + 107,000 = 659,778. Business-type (water and sewer) from proprietary statement p7; measure is net position (215,547 to 106,152). No single total revenue printed, so receipts total computed as operating sales plus nonoperating grant and interest (351,389); these lines are normal items (no outside_printed_total) because the business-type total is operating plus nonoperating. Business-type disbursements total 460,784 is printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) and equals total operating expenses 314,681 + principal 130,000 + interest 16,103 (p7). Budgetary comparison (p9, all funds combined) not recorded in detail to avoid double counting; General Fund Departments schedule (pp 10-11, left and right halves of printed p40) recorded per department for the General Fund only (Street and Keno funds have no detail schedule). Detail General fund totals tie to printed 1,042,017 and 910,291. Business-type cash-flow statement (p8) exists but is cash-basis-labelled so proprietary left null. Balance sheet uses Statement of Net Position Total column (governmental + business-type). Business-type detail: Water and Sewer lines from the all-funds budgetary comparison schedule (p9), Business-type section; they tie to the printed Total business-type 460,784 (no detail_totals entry since the total spans two funds). Receipts on that schedule mix governmental and business-type funds and are not added. Read pages 1-11 of 11. School Building and Cemetery departments are categorized streets/highways because the report's p5 General Fund Public works 51,109 equals their totals (25,113 + 25,997); General government 117,907 = Administration + Municipal Building. Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p5, p7) added for the funds that had no schedule.
